description: GRAPH-RESIDENT: the AUDIENCE-DRIVEN PRODUCTION decision (memory ozma_two_model_communication + domains/audience_driven_production.py's own 'FOR THE FOLLOW-ON' note) authored by the jabberwock via the composer (CLAUDE.md discipline: no hand-written agent rule). domains/audience_driven_production.py's audience_model/select_utterance stay the MECHANICAL machinery (a grounded SystemModel of an observed interlocutor via system_model.model_system's foreign_snapshot path, plus the joint-optimum Argmax-of-Plus render, unchanged, read-only here) -- domains/audience_production_dispatch.py's scan_and_speak_to_audience is the mechanical host hook that reads pending ProduceForAudienceRequest{status:requested} nodes, calls audience_model + select_utterance for each, and wires req -has_audience_model-> sm so the freshly-computed SystemModel (carrying the REAL grounded attr system_model.model_system already writes -- or, when the interlocutor was never observed, an honest placeholder SystemModel{grounded:false} the hook mints directly, the SAME node type/attr vocabulary the grounded case uses, since audience_model() intentionally builds NO SystemModel at all for an unobserved audience) is exposed to the rule engine as a matchable edge (the SAME idiom domains/system_model_dispatch.py's scan_and_model uses for has_system_model). THIS seed is the agent's OWN decision about WHAT TO DO with the model, mirroring composer_control_graph.json's default+override two-rule shape (default_no_response_<tag> / control_my_body_<tag>) for the load-bearing branch, plus a THIRD rule mirroring composer_communicate_graph.json's mint-a-subgoal-request shape for the request-minting step. Mints THREE rules from an agent -wants_audience_produce_rule-> ComposeRequest trigger (ground_concern's 'tailor' relation head, seeds/relation_vocabulary.json's new audience_produce cue + seeds/composer_dispatch.json's new ComposerCue, priority 23). (1) request_produce_for_audience_<tag> recognises a produce_utterance Goal that carries a for_audience edge (the world/test mechanically marking 'this utterance is meant for this interlocutor', the same kind of mechanical I/O domains/system_model_dispatch.py's mint_model_request performs for 'model this target') and mints the ProduceForAudienceRequest{status:requested} + for_goal/for_interlocutor edges -- the DECISION to model-the-audience-and-tailor, guarded by a requests_audience_produce fixpoint marker so a re-tick never re-requests. (2)+(3) are the LOAD-BEARING BRANCH, read directly off req -has_audience_model-> sm once the host hook has wired it: default_explicit_produce_<tag> DEFAULTS every request with no mode yet to 'explicit' (mirrors default_no_response_<tag>'s 'by default the environment does not respond' -- here, by default an unmodelled/ungrounded audience gets the safe explicit rendering); tailor_when_grounded_<tag> OVERRIDES to 'mode:tailor' iff sm.grounded==true (mirrors control_my_body_<tag>'s selective override) -- an ungrounded sm (grounded==false, whether a real SystemModel the host built or the honest unobserved placeholder) never matches this rule's where-guard at all, discriminative by construction, not by a second rule remembering to do nothing: the agent only tailors to an audience it actually grounded in observation, exactly the epistemic discipline domains/audience_driven_production.py's own module docstring names ('an unobserved audience contributes NOTHING to the shared-model credit, on purpose'). The mode attr the agent's own rule sets is then read back by the gate/tests alongside the host's mechanically-computed select_utterance result (terseness/grounded_used) to PIN that the two agree -- the agent's graph-resident decision and the host's mechanical rendering both key off the SAME underlying observed/grounded fact, never a host-side flag.
